title: Entries after the clock prefix
statement: Let $bs$, $\alpha$, and $x$ be finite Boolean words. For every $j\in\mathbb{N}$, the entry at index $4|bs|+4+j$ of the nested pair encoding $\langle\langle bs,\alpha\rangle,x\rangle$ equals the entry at index $j$ of $\langle\alpha,x\rangle$, with out-of-range entries interpreted as absent.
hypotheses_covered: Three arbitrary finite Boolean words $bs$, $\alpha$, and $x$
replaced:
For every $j$, cell $4|b| + 4 + j$ of the nested pair encoding
$\langle \langle b, \alpha\rangle, x\rangle$ equals cell $j$ of the inner pair
encoding $\langle \alpha, x\rangle$.
